summary: Script (artifact-cleanup.sh) is well-crafted: excellent error handling, `set -euo pipefail`, quoted vars, proper exit codes, validated input. Workflow structure is sound with proper triggers, least-privilege permissions, and job dependencies. However, critical gaps prevent full evaluation: (1) Test files (test/artifact_cleanup.bats, test/workflow_structure.bats) and fixtures (test/fixtures/*.json) not provided despite being referenced; (2) No act-result.txt generation in workflow despite task requirement "The `act-result.txt` file MUST exist when done"; (3) Workflow doesn't verify actionlint passes cleanly (has comment explaining why, but conflicts with task requirement); (4) Missing test/run-act-harness.sh which should orchestrate multi-test runs through act. The provided code is high-quality and foundational, but doesn't fulfill the stated requirement that "ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT" with verifiable output capture.
